say:1:1230227001:0.text: Cohen and I avoided the Carmine Whispers' checkpoint and sneaked in here.
say:1:1230227001:0.source_cn: 我和科恩是躲着血薇帮的关卡，偷溜进来的。
say:1:1230227001:0.male: Cohen and I avoided the Carmine Whispers' checkpoint and sneaked in here.
say:1:1230227001:0.female: Cohen and I avoided the Carmine Whispers' checkpoint and sneaked in here.

say:2:1230227002:0.text: We're watching the area first to make sure the coast's clear.
say:2:1230227002:0.source_cn: 我担心这里会有巡查人员，所以打算先观察一会儿。
say:2:1230227002:0.male: We're watching the area first to make sure the coast's clear.
say:2:1230227002:0.female: We're watching the area first to make sure the coast's clear.

say:3:1230227003:0.text: If things go awry, we'll just bolt with our rods!
say:3:1230227003:0.source_cn: 万一有情况，我们准备随时拿着鱼竿跑路！
say:3:1230227003:0.male: If things go awry, we'll just bolt with our rods!
say:3:1230227003:0.female: If things go awry, we'll just bolt with our rods!
